# Core/Maths

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [Constants.h](Constants.h): declares `radians`, `degrees`, `magnitude`, `nearlyEqual`
- [Mat4.h](Mat4.h): A 4x4 transform, stored column-major — values[column * 4 + row] — which is the layout Metal and HLSL both give a float4x4, so one of these uploads into a GPU::Uniform<Float4x4> byte for byte with nothing to transpose. (declares `Mat4`, `transformPoint`, `transformDirection`, `nearlyEqual`)
- [Maths.h](Maths.h): umbrella header: includes 3 headers
- [Vec.h](Vec.h): Plain float vectors: named components, no padding, nothing virtual, so one is laid out exactly as the float2 / float3 / float4 a shader reads. (declares `Vec2`, `Vec3`, `Vec4`, `dot`, `cross`, `lengthSquared`, `length`, `distance`, `normalize`, `min`, `max`, `lerp`, `nearlyEqual`)

<!-- agent-docs:end -->
